$sources: EN 1998-1:2004 Sec 4.3.3.4.2 (pushover analysis), Annex B (target displacement, N2)
EN 1998-3:2005 Sec 2.1 (limit states), Annex A (RC chord rotation), Annex B (steel)
source: EN 1998-1:2004 Sec 4.3.3.4.2 and Annex B; EN 1998-3:2005 Annexes A and B

sources.pattern: EN 1998-1 Sec 4.3.3.4.2.2(1): a 'modal' pattern (the first mode's shape) and a 'uniform' one; SAEngine runs the modal
sources.pushTo: EN 1998-1 Sec 4.3.3.4.2.3(2): the control node pushed to 150 % of the target displacement
sources.controlPoint: EN 1998-1 Sec 4.3.3.4.2.3(1): control node at the centre of mass at the roof
sources.sdof: EN 1998-1 Annex B.2, B.3 (Eqs B.2, B.3: m*, Γ, F*, d*)
sources.idealisation: EN 1998-1 Annex B.3 (Eq B.6: dy* by equal energies)
sources.target: EN 1998-1 Annex B.5 (Eqs B.8-B.12) and B.6 (dt = Γ·dt*)
sources.hazards: EN 1998-3 Sec 2.1(3) (return periods of the limit states); the spectrum scale of the Near Collapse level by EN 1998-1 Sec 2.1(4) Note with k = 3 (SAEngine practice)
sources.hinges: EN 1998-3 Annex A (A.3.2.2 Eq A.1, A.3.2.3, A.3.2.4) and Annex B (B.5.2)

procedure.note: EN 1998-1 asks for two lateral load patterns (modal and uniform); SAEngine runs the one chosen in the project settings. The fibre model uses the nominal strengths (the mean strengths and confidence factors of EN 1998-3 are not applied; SAEngine practice).

targetDisplacement.source: EN 1998-1 Annex B; the elastic spectrum of Sec 3.2.2.2 (q = 1)
targetDisplacement.note: dt* is capped at 3 det* (Annex B.5 Note). The spectrum of the Near Collapse and Damage Limitation levels is the design one scaled by (TLR/TL)^(1/3) (EN 1998-1 Sec 2.1(4) Note, k = 3; SAEngine practice where the National Annex gives no spectrum of its own).

acceptance.note: The chord rotation of every member end at each limit state's target displacement against that limit state's capacity.

assignment.source: EN 1993-1-1 Table 5.2 (class 1 and 2 limits, as √(E/fy) multiples with E = 210 GPa)

rcBeam.source: EN 1998-3 A.3.2.2 Eq A.1 (primary members), A.3.2.3, A.3.2.4
rcBeam.note: Members with seismic detailing (no division by 1.2), no diagonal bars (ρd = 0), bars without laps in the plastic hinge.

rcColumn.source: EN 1998-3 A.3.2.2 Eq A.1 (primary members), A.3.2.3, A.3.2.4

rcWall.source: EN 1998-3 A.3.2.2 Eq A.1 with the wall factor

steelBeam.source: EN 1998-3 B.5.2 (beams and columns in bending, class 1 and 2)

steelColumn.source: EN 1998-3 B.5.2 (beams and columns in bending, class 1 and 2; N/Npl ≤ 0.3)
steelColumn.note: Columns above N/Npl = 0.3: not covered (no row).

steelBrace.source: EN 1998-3 B.5.3 (braces in tension and in compression)

hinges.note: The hinges are assigned to the fibre model's member ends and read from its run: they do not change the analysis (SAEngine practice). θy (Damage Limitation) is the chord rotation at the first yield of the tension bars in the analysis; the shear capacity checks of EN 1998-3 A.3.3 are not covered.
